breakage_notes: The Celesto free trial allows only one retained Micro sandbox at a time. Three of five concurrent allocation attempts succeeded before the quota was reached. The remaining two were rejected by the cloud API with a capacity error. Sequential runs with unique names are used for the reliability evaluation instead of true simultaneous concurrency.
